Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

Embodiments of the present invention relate to semiconductor integrated circuit.

Background technology

In the past, a kind of automatic payment system (ETC(Electronic Toll Collection was developed System)), the charge station of toll road can pay expense automatically.In ETC, at car Carry and carried out and expense and pay relevant information by radio between device and the base station being located at charge station Transmitting-receiving, thus carry out the payment of pass cost.

ETC is different in countries in the world standard, and various countries use the most independent communication protocol.In communication protocol In the case of changing, need the LSI of ETC is designed change.It addition, in ETC, Different frame structure and synchronizing signal may be used because region is different.Such as, it some times happens that A city The ETC equipment of circle is in the unserviceable situation of B Mode of Metropolitan, and in this case, user needs to prepare Can arrange at the ETC of multiple kinds that A, B Mode of Metropolitan uses.

Here, following method can be considered: store the information corresponding with multiple communication protocols, pass through Software controls, and makes ETC arrange work with the setting corresponding with current region.But, it is impossible to enlist the services of institute Having communication protocol, there is communication protocol needs in different regions to update this problem of software.

Summary of the invention

Problem to be solved by this invention be to provide a kind of in the case of communication protocol changes also The semiconductor integrated circuit of the transmitting-receiving of data can be carried out.
